title: 驚愕ッ！理事長のサプライズ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm summoned to the director's office out of the blue. I fear I've made some great blunder, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out Director Akikawa simply wanted to offer some words of praise face-to-face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She appears highly pleased with everything <chrname> has accomplished this past year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While processing these feelings of joy, I once again resolve to do my best with my partner!
